title: Common Fixed Points of Co-Cyclic and Sub-Cyclic Mappings in Complete Metric Spaces
summary: In this paper, we introduce two new classes of cyclic-type mappings, namely, co-cyclic mappings and sub-cyclic mappings, defined on the union of two subsets of a metric space. Under suitable Jungck-type contractive conditions and compatibility assumptions, we establish unique common fixed point theorems for these mappings in complete metric spaces. The proofs are based on the construction of appropriate sequences, the associated contractive conditions, and the completeness of the underlying metric space.
